name: player_remove_all_deployed_mines
description: Player::RemoveAllDeployedMines removes deployed mine runtime instances from the four mine alt-weapon controller slots owned by the player's root node.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Player weapon-bank/Mines source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43c950 validates ECX as zUtil_SaveGameState, saveState->playerState at offset 4, mine controller entries at PlayerState alt banks 4 and 5 controller A/B, rootNode at offset 0xed0, and four guarded OptCatalog::RemoveRuntimeInstance(entry, null, rootNode) calls.
The native Player smoke verifies entries in banks 4A, 4B, 5A, and 5B are removed and recycled while a non-mine bank 3 entry remains active.
